hookText: Tao: AI also cracked Navier-Stokes blowup

beats.say: Terence Tao reports that Levent Alpöge and Tristan Buckmaster, again with heavy AI usage, have generated a proof of finite-time blowup for the unforced, incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in three dimensions, again with a Lean formalization.
Alpöge, using an internal AI model, also generated an enormous Lean-only proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis.
Tao points readers to Buckmaster's Mastodon post for more on the first two results.
